trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The left lobe exhibits a series of low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations with roughly 3-8 pixel depths. The right lobe displays extreme high-amplitude irregularities, including multiple deep semi-circular voids (approx. 20-50 pixels in depth) and jagged peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The lobes exhibit an upward convex sweep. The left lobe follows a relatively continuous parabolic curve, while the right lobe's trajectory is fractured by irregular tissue loss along the distal half of its length.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The right lobe shows significant irregular fragmentation of the trailing edge and a distinct, small circular perforation or isolated notch near the upper terminal edge. White specular highlights at the lobe tips suggest moisture or minor surface pitting but do not form clear constellations.
other_distinctive_markers: Severe morphological asymmetry between the lobes; the right fluke lobe is significantly more eroded and jagged than the left lobe.
